description: KNaPrNbO₅ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/nmm space group. K is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and four longer (2.30 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Pr is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.50 Å. Nb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NbO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.86 Å) and four longer (1.98 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Pr, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Nb atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OK₄NaNb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 10°.
